First archived release of the code, data and paper.

- Control loop: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing with a CUSUM lapse detector, a PID complexity governor (set-point P* = 0.95, gains tuned on a separate seed), a rule-based policy, and a validation gate with a deterministic fallback.
- Generative plant: Gemini 3.7 Flash on Vertex AI. In guided mode a layout planner fixes the structure and the model writes the content (300 real calls: schema compliance 0.987, within budget 0.987, median latency 2.7 s).
- Frontend: React renderer for the six CLT-UI components, a symbolic step checker, and live telemetry.
- Evaluation: simulation only, with 1,000 synthetic learners, 3 archetypes and 4 arms, plus weight-sensitivity and tuning runs (results/).
- Paper: paper/main.tex, with paper.pdf attached to this release.

No human-subject data is included.
